owner.name: Jonah Okafor
owner.public_bio: Founder of Tabby (accounts payable for restaurants). Head of SMB Sales at Tide, ex-Deliveroo ops. London.

items.title: Tabby thesis
items.text: Restaurants pay 10 to 30 suppliers a week from WhatsApp messages, paper invoices and bank transfers at midnight. Tabby reads the invoices, matches them to deliveries, queues payments. 6 pilots in London, 2 paying 49/month. The product is a spreadsheet with a brain right now. I need a real technical cofounder.

Kofi: so when are you quitting Tide? Jonah: my cliff is 14 Feb. Kofi: and if something great comes before? Jonah: honestly if the right thing came I'd walk from the cliff, it's like 18k. I just need to be able to pay rent until we raise.

items.subject: Runway maths
items.text: Savings: about 5 months of rent and bills. Hard floor: I need to draw at least 4,000 a month within 3 months of going full-time, otherwise I'm back job hunting. Below that is not an option with the flat.

Ade: what split did you do with your cofounder? Jonah: haven't got one yet. I'd want 50/50, that's how you show you're equals. Ade: and if they've been building longer? Jonah: then fine, a bit less, but I wouldn't go under 45. Under that I'm an employee with a title.

items.title: What I want my job to be
items.text: I want to be CEO. I want to be the one in the room with investors and customers. I need to talk to customers every week or I die inside. I would not join a pure dev tools or infra company where the customer is an engineer I never meet.

Jonah: been reading about stablecoin settlement for supplier payments, could kill the 3 day wait for small suppliers. Ade: you building that? Jonah: maybe someday. It's a cool idea, not the business. Restaurants don't care how the money moves, they care that it's on time.

items.subject: Re: invoice matching
items.text: Marco: the matching saved my manager 4 hours last week. Honestly what I want is for it to just pay the suppliers itself when the delivery is confirmed, with a limit per supplier. Jonah: That's exactly where we're going.

items.title: Tabby pilot list
items.text: Trattoria Sole (paying), Bao Street (paying), Dishoom-style group of 3 sites (pilot), Hackney Coffee Co (pilot), Pho Tram (pilot), The Green Room (pilot). All London. Common ask: auto-pay suppliers with limits and approvals.
Kofi: would you ever move to SF for this? Jonah: never say never but my customers are all in London and Mum needs me around on Sundays. Not this year.

items.title: Recurring: Tide pipeline review
items.text: Mon to Fri, 09:00 to 18:00 blocked as day job. Tabby customer calls 18:30 to 20:00 and Saturdays.

items.title: Cofounder must-haves
items.text: Technical, has shipped payments or fintech before. Lets me own sales and fundraising. Keeps my pilot customers as design partners, I promised them. Ideally London, I like being in a room 2 days a week. Standard vesting is fine.

items.caption: Photo at Trattoria Sole kitchen pass with Marco, holding a stack of supplier invoices. Caption: 'the enemy'.

items.subject: Tabby
items.text: Ifeoma: I'd write a 25k cheque the day you have a technical cofounder full-time. Jonah: Working on it. Meeting someone through Priya next week.

Ade: who are you meeting? Jonah: Maya, ex-Stripe, built agent payments infra. Worried it's too infra for me. But if her rails could make Tabby pay suppliers on its own, that's the product Marco keeps asking for.
